thread:
anya_arch: Quick sync — wanted to capture constraints and launch criteria for the long-term regional affinity + tenant isolation work. Short thread, pls chime in.

sarah_pm: TL;DR we have 3 customer asks: strong data isolation, predictable p99 latency across regions, and route-level SLA/budget controls. They want timeline and go/no-go criteria by EOW.

miguel_eng: Agreed. We also need to standardize policy primitives so Dedicated/Private/Hosted can use same config. Otherwise config drift will kill us.

kevin_sre: Ops note: multi-region affinity adds complexity for state (KV cache, warmup) and for failover order. Need clear fallback priority (local -> regional -> global) and a quarantine mode for noisy tenants.

lina_research: We ran sim tests on cross-region cold starts — median token latency jumps 2.5x when KV miss rates >30%. Prefetch + sticky routing helps but increases cost.

anya_arch: Proposed policy primitives (high-level):
- affinity: region/zone hint
- isolation_level: shared / dedicated_slice / fully_dedicated
- fallback_policy: failover_order + max_replication_distance
- cost_cap: tokens-per-minute cap with soft throttles

miguel_eng: Love that. Implementation notes:
```
# example routing policy
affinity:
  type: region
  preferred: [us-west-2, us-east-1]
isolation_level: dedicated_slice
fallback_policy:
  order: [regional, cross-region, fallthrough]
  max_hops: 2
cost_cap:
  tpm: 5000
  action: degrade-to-quantized
```

sarah_pm: For launch criteria, customers asked for explicit metrics. Suggest:
- p99 latency delta vs baseline < 1.3x
- failure blast radius < 1 tenant per zone
- SLA: 99.9% regional routing success
- documented rollback and canary playbook

kevin_sre: Add: automated circuit breaker if regional latency > threshold for >5m. Playbook must include tenant quarantine steps.

lina_research: Also add quality guardrails: prompt-level evals to detect regression when routing to quantized/backup models.

miguel_eng: Scope negotiation: we cannot deliver "fully_dedicated" for all customers day-1. Proposal: ship 3 phased deliverables:
1) Phase A (MVP): affinity hints + simple fallback order + observability (30 days)
2) Phase B: isolation slices + cost_cap enforcement + canary tooling (60-90 days)
3) Phase C: deterministic dedicated pools + private deployment support (quarterly)

anya_arch: Dependencies: kernel selection for quantized fallbacks (eng-runtime), routing control plane (eng-platform), and SRE automation (eng-sre).

sarah_pm: Customer asks prioritized: 1) isolation SLAs (enterprise), 2) cross-region p99 (growth customers), 3) cost controls (platform). We'll reflect in roadmap.

kevin_sre: Risk register quick notes: KV cache warmups, cross-region network flaps, tenant noisy neighbors. Mitigations: adaptive prefetch, tenant throttles, and regional quarantine.

miguel_eng: Open question — how do we expose policies? YAML in Console + API? I vote both. Console for product teams, API for infra automation.

anya_arch: Agreed. Console + YAML + API. Also we should version policies and allow dry-run to simulate route decisions.

deploy-bot: canary: routing-control-v1 scheduled for staging at 2026-11-12T03:00Z

sarah_pm: Action items:
- miguel: draft API schema for routing primitives (due in 3 days)
- kevin: prod playbook + circuit breaker runbook (5 days)
- lina: perf sims for KV miss scenarios (7 days)
- anya: update roadmap doc and stakeholder summary (EOW)

miguel_eng: I'll start schema and include examples for Hosted/Dedicated/Private.

kevin_sre: I'll mock remediation steps and add runbook templates.

lina_research: Will run sims with varying tenant churn and report perf/cost tradeoffs.

anya_arch: Great. If no objections I'll publish a short summary to execs after we have the API draft. :thumbsup:

sarah_pm: No objections from me.

miguel_eng: +1

kevin_sre: +1

lina_research: +1

anya_arch: Closing thread, will post follow-ups in product-roadmap channel.
